name: Devx Version Tag Automation

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  create-dev-tag:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Setup Git
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Determine Latest Release and Create Dev Tag
        id: tag_logic
        run: |
          # Fetch all tags to ensure we have the latest state
          git fetch --tags --force

          # Get the latest release tag (excluding dev tags)
          # We assume release tags follow semantic versioning or similar, and dev tags end in .dev*
          LATEST_RELEASE=$(git tag -l --sort=-v:refname | grep -v '\.dev' | head -n 1)

          if [ -z "$LATEST_RELEASE" ]; then
            echo "No releases found. Skipping dev tag creation."
            exit 0
          fi

          echo "Latest release tag: $LATEST_RELEASE"

          # Find the highest existing .dev* tag for this release
          # Pattern: ${LATEST_RELEASE}.dev*
          # We sort them numerically to find the highest N
          HIGHEST_DEV_TAG=$(git tag -l "${LATEST_RELEASE}.dev*" | sort -V | tail -n 1)

          if [ -z "$HIGHEST_DEV_TAG" ]; then
            NEXT_DEV_NUM=0
          else
            # Extract the number from the tag (e.g., 12 from v1.0.0.dev12)
            CURRENT_DEV_NUM=$(echo "$HIGHEST_DEV_TAG" | grep -oP '\.dev\K\d+')
            NEXT_DEV_NUM=$((CURRENT_DEV_NUM + 1))
          fi

          NEW_TAG="${LATEST_RELEASE}.dev${NEXT_DEV_NUM}"
          echo "Creating new tag: $NEW_TAG"

          # Retry logic for tag collision
          MAX_RETRIES=3
          RETRY_COUNT=0
          SUCCESS=false

          while [ $RETRY_COUNT -lt $MAX_RETRIES ] && [ "$SUCCESS" != "true" ]; do
            # Check if tag already exists locally or remotely
            if git tag -l | grep -q "^${NEW_TAG}$"; then
              echo "Tag $NEW_TAG already exists. Incrementing and retrying..."
              NEXT_DEV_NUM=$((NEXT_DEV_NUM + 1))
              NEW_TAG="${LATEST_RELEASE}.dev${NEXT_DEV_NUM}"
              RETRY_COUNT=$((RETRY_COUNT + 1))
              continue
            fi

            # Create and push the tag
            git tag -a "$NEW_TAG" -m "Development version $NEW_TAG based on $LATEST_RELEASE"
            if git push origin "$NEW_TAG"; then
              echo "Successfully pushed tag $NEW_TAG"
              SUCCESS=true
            else
              echo "Failed to push tag $NEW_TAG. Retrying..."
              RETRY_COUNT=$((RETRY_COUNT + 1))
              # Small delay to avoid rate limiting or race conditions
              sleep 2
            fi
          done

          if [ "$SUCCESS" != "true" ]; then
            echo "Failed to create tag after $MAX_RETRIES retries."
            exit 1
          fi
